encode_gaussian_simcc_labels: encode keypoints into SimCC labels using the gaussian smoothing strategy with configurable sigma
encode_standard_simcc_labels: encode keypoints into SimCC labels using the standard label smoothing strategy
decode_simcc_to_keypoints: decode SimCC x and y representations back to keypoint coordinates and scores
refine_keypoints_with_dark: decode SimCC labels with DART-based refinement to improve keypoint coordinate accuracy
map_coordinates_to_simcc_space: map raw keypoint coordinates into the SimCC label space using the split ratio
